meta.review_notes: Strict legal-safe re-analysis. Location & GPS, Children's Data Handling, and Health & Biometric Data marked as unknown due to silence in policy. Contact syncing downgraded from risky to caution due to weak evidence. Data sharing and behavioral tracking downgraded due to explicit opt-out controls and no data sale. Policy change notification upgraded to safe because text explicitly promises notice for significant changes. Score: 74 (Grade B).

app.name: Discord – Talk, Play, Hang Out
app.description: A voice, video, and text chat app designed for communities, gamers, and friends.

verdict.one_liner: States it does not sell your data, offers e2e calls and privacy controls, but receives outside behavioral data.
verdict.summary: Discord collects your messages, usage patterns, and device information. It explicitly states it does not sell personal information. It offers end-to-end encryption for calls and privacy settings to limit personalization. However, it may receive demographic and behavioral data about you from third-party advertisers and data providers, and uses your information to deliver sponsored content like Quests.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Discord is better than many social apps because it explicitly states it does not sell your data and lets you opt out of personalization. However, it still receives behavioral data from outside sources and uses it for sponsored content. Use privacy settings to limit personalization if concerned.

red.title: Discord may receive data about you from outside sources
red.plain_english: Discord states it may receive information about you from advertisers and third-party data providers, such as demographic information and how you engage with other products and services outside of Discord.

red.title: Your behavior may fuel sponsored content
red.plain_english: Discord states it uses your information to help surface sponsored content like Quests and to advertise Discord on other platforms. It also states it may receive behavioral data from third parties.

red.title: Your messages may be scanned for policy violations
red.plain_english: Discord states it proactively scans attachments and other content for illegal or harmful activity, and uses certain content to create systems and models that detect prohibited content or conduct.

red.title: Contact syncing may access information on your device
red.plain_english: Discord states that certain features, like contact syncing, may require that you provide additional information or grant access to such information to make them work.

green.title: Discord states it does not sell your personal data
green.plain_english: Discord explicitly states: 'We don't sell your personal information.' It says its business is funded through subscriptions, paid products, and sponsored content.

green.title: Voice and video calls are designed to be end-to-end encrypted
green.plain_english: Discord states that voice and video communications on Discord are designed to be end-to-end encrypted, and you can verify this in the service.

green.title: You can turn off personalization and delete your account
green.plain_english: Discord states it gives you settings to limit how your data is used for personalization and service improvement. You can also permanently delete your account and request a copy of your data.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Discord may access your camera and microphone when you start a voice or video call. It states calls are designed to be end-to-end encrypted.
categories.detail: Camera and microphone access is user-initiated for voice and video calls. Discord states it does not store the contents of video or voice calls or channels. Voice and video communications are designed to be end-to-end encrypted.
categories.policy_excerpt: Voice and video communications on Discord are designed to be end-to-end encrypted.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not clearly state whether Discord accesses your GPS location.
categories.detail: The privacy policy does not mention GPS or precise location access. IP address is collected as device information, which may infer a general region.

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Discord states that contact syncing may require access to information on your device. It does not clearly explain what data is collected or stored.
categories.detail: Contact syncing is mentioned as an optional feature. The policy states it may require access to 'such information' but does not explicitly describe uploading contacts to servers.
categories.policy_excerpt: Certain features, like contact syncing, may require that you provide additional information (or grant us access to such information) to make them work.
concerns: Policy is vague about what contact data is accessed

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Discord states you may upload and share files through the services. This is user-initiated.
categories.detail: File and media access is user-initiated for sharing content in messages or servers. There is no indication of background file scanning.
categories.policy_excerpt: You may also upload and share files through the services.

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Discord states it shares limited information with advertising platforms, vendors, and related companies, but explicitly says it does not sell your personal data.
categories.detail: Discord discloses data to vendors (payment processors, cloud providers), provides limited information to advertising platforms for Discord's own ads, shares with related companies, and in corporate transactions. It explicitly states it does not sell personal data.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may provide limited information to advertising platforms to help us reach people that we think will like our products and to measure the performance of our ads shown on those platforms.
concerns: Data may be transferred in a merger or acquisition

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Discord states you must provide an email or phone number and birthday to create an account. You may also add a display name.
categories.detail: Account creation requires a username, password, email or phone number, and birthday. Additional information like a verified phone number or display name may be required or optional.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you create a Discord account, you can come up with a username and password, and provide a way of contacting you (such as an email address and/or phone number). You'll also need to provide your birthday.
concerns: Phone number may be required for verification

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Discord states it may receive behavioral and demographic data about you from third-party advertisers and data providers, and uses your information to personalize content and deliver sponsored experiences.
categories.detail: Discord collects usage information and may receive data about how you engage with other products and services outside of Discord. It uses this to personalize the product and deliver sponsored content like Quests. Users can opt out of personalization in settings.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may receive information about you from advertisers and third-party data providers, such as demographic information and how you engage with other products and services outside of Discord.
concerns: Receives behavioral data from outside sources
Targeted sponsored content within the app

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not clearly state how Discord handles children's data.
categories.detail: No specific children's data handling information found in the reviewed privacy policy.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Discord states it logs your IP address, the pages and channels you visit, and your activities to keep the service running and secure.
categories.detail: Discord collects IP address, browser information, pages and servers visited, features used, and interaction logs. This is used for security, service operation, and personalization.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect information about the pages, servers, and channels you visit, the activities you engage in, the features you use, and the surfaces or embedded content you interact with.
concerns: IP address logged and used for security and personalization

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Discord states it collects your device type, operating system, browser, and IP address to run the app and keep it secure.
categories.detail: Device information collected includes IP address, operating system, browser information, and device settings. This is used for security, service operation, and to personalize the experience.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect information about the device you are using to access the services. For example, this includes information like your IP address, operating system information, browser information, and information about your device settings.

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not clearly state whether Discord collects health or biometric data.
categories.detail: The privacy policy does not mention collection of health or biometric data.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Discord states that if you buy something, your payment details are handled by companies like Stripe and PayPal. Discord may keep the last four digits of your card.
categories.detail: Payment information is processed by third-party payment processors (Stripe, PayPal). Discord may receive and store certain billing information including the last four digits of the credit card number.
categories.policy_excerpt: Our payment processors, like Stripe and PayPal, receive and process your payment information. Depending on the processor, we may also receive and store certain billing information, including the last four digits of the credit card number.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: Discord states you can delete your account or request a copy of your data, but some information may be kept for legal reasons.
categories.detail: Users can disable or delete their account. Deleting permanently deletes identifying information and anonymizes other data. Users can request a copy of their data within 30 days. Some data may be retained for legal obligations.
categories.policy_excerpt: Deleting your account permanently deletes identifying information and anonymizes other data as described in our data retention policy.
concerns: Some data retained after deletion for legal reasons

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Discord states it will notify you of significant privacy policy changes as required by law, such as by emailing you or highlighting changes in the app.
categories.detail: Discord states it updates its privacy policy from time to time and indicates the date of last changes. For significant changes, it says it will provide a more prominent notice as required by law.
categories.policy_excerpt: We will update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We always indicate the date the last changes were published, and if changes are significant, we'll provide a more prominent notice as required by law, such as by emailing you or highlighting the changes within the services.
